fix(postgres): preserve leases on unknown readback

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-51
  description: |-
    Treat missing or incomplete containment evidence from any owned dispatch as an unknown startup runtime outcome before applying a non-Agent operation's not-applicable lease contract.
    
    Cover both NULL readback and missing-containment cases so startup enters Recovery Required and retains the held runnable lease.
